episodes.211179: A stationary frontal boundary extending from Kansas City eastward to near Cincinnati, Ohio triggered scattered showers and thunderstorms during the afternoon of February 28th.  The convection north of the boundary across central Illinois was elevated in nature, with one cell producing marginally-severe hail in Sangamon County.
episodes.211306: A departing cold front brought winds in excess of 55 mph late on the 27th into the early hours of the 28th.
episodes.211339: A thunderstorm moving offshore along a cold front produced a strong wind gust at the coast.
episodes.211340: A thunderstorm moving offshore produced severe hail in St Lucie County.
episodes.211505: A frontal boundary north of Lake Okeechobee, abundant moisture over South Florida, and a mid-level disturbance combined on the afternoon of February 28th to spur strong to severe thunderstorms.
